notes.title: About Ver. 1.2 update.
notes.content:
Hello, one month have passed from release of "絵話-kaiwa-".
The story was interested in many people, and I perform update work very happily, too.
Now, I would like to inform you of the Ver. 1.2 update of "絵話-kaiwa-".
We have updated the contents of the previously announced update, as well as some new parts that we think are necessary.

The contents of the update to Ver. 1.2.

・Chinese translation is implemented.
・Correction of in-game credits and notes.

This time, Chinese (Simplified Chinese) translation was implemented.
Korean translation is also in progress and will be implemented around August.
Please look forward to it.
I want to do working still more. One of them is to add new chapters.
I am working on it little by little but surely.
The next Ver1.3 update is scheduled around August.
Thank you for always enjoying our games.

852wa.

notes.title: 2022.06.21 Ver1.1 Update
notes.content:
Ver1.1 Update!
I will update Ver1.1 earlier than I had announced.
The update includes the following two items.
・ Correction of the chapter selection screen at the entrance.
・Translation from Japanese to English.

Thank you for your continued support.
852wa

notes.title: Updates about the Update.
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Ten days passed since the released of "絵話-kaiwa-".
I am very happy to report that more players have picked up the game  I expected.
Thank you.

I felt that the "visual novel genre" has more possibilities than before.
Now, I would like to inform you an advance notice of the Ver. 1.1 update of "絵話-kaiwa-".
I announced before, I'm planning several updates for "絵話-kaiwa-"
It will be mainly the addition of new chapters and translation work.
The following two updates will be made for the Ver. 1.1 update.

・ Correction of the chapter selection screen at the entrance.
・Translation from Japanese to English.

Korean and Chinese translations are also in the working.
However those will be coming in a few more updates.
I will taking more effort to make this a better game.
I am working on this game as an individual.
I draw the pictures, I make the music, I create the scenarios...
All of them make myself.
Therefor, sometimes it takes a long time.
At such times, players  comments and responses are very  encouraging for me.
I appreciate every player.
The Ver 1.1 update is scheduled for July at the earliest.
Don't miss it!

Many thanks!

852wa
